services.name: Private Tours
services.desc: Wave Hill is a spectacular public garden and cultural center overlooking the majestic Hudson River and Palisades in the Riverdale section of the Bronx. Its mission is to celebrate the artistry and legacy of its gardens and landscapes, to preserve its magnificent views, and to explore human connections to the natural world through programs in horticulture, education and the arts. Take a tour of our vibrant, intimate 28-acre site. Focusing on seasonal highlights, a Wave Hill Garden Guide will give an overview of our carefully cultivated gardens and extensive collection of rare and unusual plants, along with a general history of the property. services.name: Weddings & Private Events
services.desc: Wave Hill's acclaimed gardens and spectacular views of the Hudson River provide the perfect setting for weddings, rehearsal dinners and other special celebrations. Ceremonies take place at the Pergola on the Great Lawn or directly below on our expansive Lower Lawn. Cocktail hour can be hosted on either the Great Lawn, Lower Lawn, or the Kate French Terrace at historic Wave Hill House. The terrace attached to Wave Hill House is two-thirds covered with a three-season semi-permanent tent. Seated dinners are held in Armor Hall with capacity capped at 120 guests if plans include a small band or DJ and dance floor in the Hall.
